steps.en: OCMS compares the received address with the one it holds
steps.id: OCMS membandingkan alamat yang diterima dengan alamat yang dipegang
steps.why_en: Comparison exists only inside a report, is not stored per person, and relies on a tag column never filled.
steps.why_id: Perbandingan hanya ada di laporan, tidak disimpan per orang, dan bergantung pada kolom penanda yang tidak pernah diisi.

steps.en: A work item lists the old address and the new address
steps.id: Work item memuat alamat lama dan alamat baru
steps.why_en: Old and new addresses appear as rows in a spreadsheet report, not as a work item with status and owner.
steps.why_id: Alamat lama dan baru muncul sebagai baris laporan spreadsheet, bukan work item dengan status dan pemilik.

steps.en: The work item appears on the officer's dashboard
steps.id: Work item muncul di dashboard petugas
steps.why_en: The officer only gets an emailed summary of totals; no dashboard item is created for each person.
steps.why_id: Petugas hanya menerima email ringkasan angka total; tidak ada item dashboard untuk tiap orang.

steps.en: The officer follows up on the person in the staff portal
steps.id: Petugas menindaklanjuti orang tersebut di portal staf
steps.why_en: Update and lift screens exist, but the officer must search the person manually; nothing leads there from a work item.
steps.why_id: Layar update dan cabut ada, tetapi petugas harus mencari orangnya sendiri; tidak ada work item yang mengarah ke sana.
